_what: Throw Food for Anime - FestivalLane v2 (corridor lanes). GENERATED by tools/map/gen_map.py from design/game.json (config.World, Server.PlotCount, Zones), tools/map/zones.json and design/kit.json + the mesh manifests; do not hand-edit, change the generator or the data.
name: FestivalLane
style: bright stylised anime world; one key colour per zone
axis: lanes run along +Z from the plot row; plots are spaced along X

baseparts.note: plain parts + MeshParts inside each model (manifest colour parts)

volume.lift_reason: config.World.GroundY = 0 is a game contract: the client renders pedestal tops at y=1 and food at y=0.2, so the map cannot be raised. Nothing sits ON y=0 by construction instead: terrain walking surfaces at about -1 (heightfield -3), decks top 0.4, strips 0.3, zone lines 0.42, pads 0.7, pedestals 1.0; water surface -4. tools/map/emit_chunks.py audits the EMITTED heights.

budget.instances_reason: RAISED from 12,000: 6966 placements, of which 4506 are plain trim/floor Parts (brief B/C: kerbs, paving, plinths, pilasters, hung elements, parapets), non-colliding and batched by material; research 06 s2.2: no official instance budget exists
budget.shadowCasters_reason: the prover counts 6234 boxes as casters; the emitter sets CastShadow=false on all but 3986 of them (trims, floor paint, far layers: research 06 s2.1)
budget.reason: RAISED from the skill default 1.5M, deliberately and flagged: the owner asked for a prop every 12-16 studs along 12 wall feet of a 2160-stud corridor. Fixed pieces (plots, hub, gates, skyline) alone are ~1.0M. The phone budget in design/plan/04 s5 is 1.2M IN VIEW at the plot row with zone props streamed: ~1,287,984 triangles stand within 600 studs of the plot row. Every per-model budget is unchanged. Strict variant: gen_map.py --tris-budget 1450000.
